services.name: How to Purchase Tickets
services.desc: All INDOOR SEATS will be RESERVED. OUTDOOR seats (benches but uncovered) are by General Admission. ROCK BOTTOM seating (bring your own chair) is by donation and is available only at the Box Office. Tickets may be purchased online by credit card up to two hours before each concert. Service fees apply. To purchase tickets online, go to our schedule page and the concert(s) of your choice, select the “Buy Tickets” button and follow instructions. Tickets purchased online can be printed out or displayed on your phone for entry. The Maverick Box Office opens one-hour before each performance. blurb: Maverick Concerts is the oldest ongoing summer chamber music festival in the U.S., attracting the best musicians in the world for over a century. In addition to classical music, Maverick features jazz, contemporary, folk and world music.
